periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree oblique angle slanting upwards and outwards from the snout toward the temporal regions.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with vertical elongation; height-to-width ratio is approximately 1.4:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Notable downward tapering present below the geometric center, resulting in a teardrop-shaped profile.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped profile along the posterior margin of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick band covering the entire shoulder girdle and proximal forelimbs.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation between ears, roughly 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, consistently rounded convex curvature at the superior boundary.
